desc: Build a segment decomposition (constant‑value runs) of the suffix maximum array for any interval.
Implement a function that returns \(g(A,j)\) for the right side in \(O(\log n)\) using the segments.
For the left side, reverse the subarray, build its segment decomposition, and use it to obtain `left_max[i]` and `left_cost[i]` for every `i` in the left half.
Write a recursive `solve(l,r)` that counts all subarrays inside \([l,r]\) and, using the two‑pointer method, adds the crossing subarrays.
Combine the results and return the total count.
